coonawarra.name: Coonawarra
coonawarra.summary: Cool southern conditions and terra rossa soils produce structured Cabernet with signature mint and cassis.

cabernet-sauvignon.expect: Structured and cassis-driven, often with minty freshness and firm tannin.

margaret-river.name: Margaret River
margaret-river.summary: Ocean influence gives polished, aromatic wines with ripe fruit but notable freshness.

cabernet-sauvignon.expect: Polished Cabernet with cassis, bay leaf and cedar, balancing ripeness with freshness.

chardonnay.expect: Powerful yet taut Chardonnay, with citrus, stone fruit and savory oak.

stellenbosch.name: Stellenbosch
stellenbosch.summary: Warm sun plus cooling breezes produce ripe but structured reds and expressive whites.

cabernet-sauvignon.expect: Ripe and structured, with cassis, cedar and a distinctive herbal-savory edge.

syrah.expect: Dark-fruited and peppery, combining warmth with savory South African character.

chenin-blanc.expect: Textured and ripe, with quince, apple and waxy complexity held by Chenin's acidity.

maipo.name: Maipo Valley
maipo.summary: Sunny days and cool nights favor ripe Cabernet with herbal lift and firm structure.

cabernet-sauvignon.expect: Ripe cassis and blackberry meet minty, herbal freshness and firm tannin.

rheingau.name: Rheingau
rheingau.summary: A classic Riesling region known for more body and structure than the Mosel while retaining high acidity.

riesling.expect: More structured than Mosel Riesling, with citrus, stone fruit and firm acidity.

clare-valley.name: Clare Valley
clare-valley.summary: Altitude and cool nights help preserve intense acidity in famously dry, lime-driven Riesling.

riesling.expect: Dry, piercing and lime-driven, often developing toast and mineral complexity with age.

sancerre.name: Sancerre
sancerre.summary: Loire Sauvignon Blanc at its most taut and mineral, emphasizing citrus, herbs and stony freshness.

sauvignon-blanc.expect: Lean, citrusy and mineral, with restrained fruit and herbal-flinty detail.

vouvray.name: Vouvray
vouvray.summary: Chenin Blanc ranges from dry to sweet, united by high acidity, orchard fruit and strong ageing potential.

chenin-blanc.expect: High-acid and versatile, with quince, pear and honeyed complexity depending on sweetness and age.

brunello.name: Brunello di Montalcino
brunello.summary: A powerful, ageworthy Sangiovese expression with more body, tannin and ripeness than Chianti Classico.

sangiovese.expect: Powerful and ageworthy, with cherry, plum, herbs, leather and firm tannin.

barbaresco.name: Barbaresco
barbaresco.summary: Nebbiolo with similar perfume and structure to Barolo, generally a little more approachable earlier.

nebbiolo.expect: Perfumed and structured, with rose, cherry and savory complexity, often slightly less forbidding than Barolo.

southern-rhone.name: Southern Rhône
southern-rhone.summary: Sun-baked, herbal and generous, with Grenache commonly at the heart of blends.

grenache.expect: Warm, generous and herbal, with ripe red fruit, licorice and garrigue.
